meta.title: TradeWithBardia — Systematic Trading Research & Education
meta.description: A structured trading process, studied through data. Setup research, a learning path, and tools for analysing your own execution.

hero.lead: A defined process for reading liquidity, structure and execution — written down, tested against data, and taught step by step.
hero.sceneDescription: A scroll-driven diagram walking through one setup: market context, liquidity, sweep, market structure shift, fair value gap, then entry with a defined stop and target.

noise.label: Noise
noise.caption: Most of what you see is not a signal.

structure.label: Structure
structure.caption: Highs and lows start to describe intent.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.caption: Resting orders pool where everyone agrees.

sweep.label: Sweep
sweep.caption: The level is taken. That is the point of it.

mss.label: Market structure shift
mss.caption: Direction changes, and it is measurable.

fvg.label: Fair value gap
fvg.caption: The imbalance left behind becomes the location.

entry.label: Execution
entry.caption: Entry, stop and target defined before the trade.

system.label: System
system.caption: One repeatable process, not one lucky trade.

process.title: Every trade is an input to the next one
process.lead: The process is a closed loop. Data from execution feeds back into research, and research changes what gets traded.

context.label: Context
context.body: What kind of market is this, and does it suit the setup at all?

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.body: Where are the resting orders, and which side is likely to be taken first?

structure.label: Structure
structure.body: Has direction actually shifted, by a rule that can be checked?

setup.label: Setup
setup.body: Does this match a written specification, or is it an improvisation?

execution.label: Execution
execution.body: Entry, stop and target are decided before risk is taken.

review.label: Review
review.body: Was the rule followed? That question is separate from whether it won.

data.label: Data
data.body: Enough samples, and the process starts describing its own behaviour.

disclosures.synthetic: Illustrative diagram. Synthetic price data, not a trade record and not a performance claim.
disclosures.research: Research data under study. No validated edge is claimed, and no minimum sample size has been met.
disclosures.demo: Demo data. Placeholder values standing in for a source that is not connected yet.
